name: Give It Time
source:
"Give It Time" is a short experimental & layered VN that focuses on 6 individuals during one month in 1988, and the web that has brought them together.

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/give-it-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Give It Time》是一部篇幅简短、具有实验性质与多层结构的视觉小说，聚焦1988年某个月里的六个人，以及将他们联系在一起的关系网。

[来源：[url=https://norbez.itch.io/give-it-time]Itch.io[/url]]
